description: Real-time two-way speech translation for bilingual meetings, cloud or fully offline. Registers itself as a virtual microphone, so Zoom, Meet, Teams and any other app hears the translated speech.
notes: Windows audio routing needs VB-CABLE, which the installer does not bundle: install it from https://vb-audio.com/Cable/ (the app's audio setup page can do it too), then reboot so CABLE Input/Output show up.
The app ships its own updater. When it offers an update, choose Later and run 'scoop update sokuji' instead, so Scoop keeps owning the installed copy.
Settings, transcripts and the downloaded on-device model bundles stay in %APPDATA%\sokuji and are not removed by 'scoop uninstall'.
